Episode 258. The Predator of All Dimensions (5)
[As you wish.]

The Immortal. Kelliark commanded even the beings that humans called gods as his own limbs. Following Olta, high-ranking gods such as Shinu, Melzair, Itelmion, and Likta continued to emerge from the dimensional gate.
Dozens of phoenixes, including Bellot, Maniere, and Sankish, were also exiting the portal. The order of one contract, one phoenix, naturally did not apply to Kelliark at all.
[Gaaaaaaak...!]
[Kiiiiik!]

If there was any silver lining, it was the fact that the gods' authority seemed limited. The phoenixes, on the other hand, resonated with Kelliark's magic, spewing flames more powerful than the level commonly known in this world.
[L- Lord Olta...]
Quicantel couldn't escape her shock.
[Quicantel, that is not your Olta!]
Murakan shouted. Of course, Quicantel knew that too. But she was simply crushed by instinct and unable to move.
A silver beam extended from Olta's grasp and flew towards Quicantel.
No one could help Quicantel. Murakan was too busy protecting the entire allied force, and the Genesis Knights were in the middle of enduring the attacks of Kelliark and his kin.
So she had to dodge it herself, but Quicantel couldn't move at all, not even as the silver beam pierced her heart.
Puk...!
[Keok...!]
Blood poured from Quicantel's mouth. From the hole in her chest, shattered pieces of her heart were falling.
The Silver Dragon. Normally, she would have turned back her own time to postpone death. But her opponent, though his authority was limited, was Olta.
'I can't turn it back.'
Though not outwardly visible, Olta's beam was binding Quicantel's authority.
Inevitable death was approaching. The past years flashed through Quicantel's mind.
They were mostly regretful memories. Not participating in the Sword Demon War a thousand years ago, losing Murakan, losing Temar...
'I can't end with only regrets.'
But with them were the memories of meeting Enya, meeting Jin, and meeting her comrades. And the memory of this very moment, fighting to protect the world.
A guardian dragon, under any circumstances, prioritizes the contractor's safety above all else.
But now, Quicantel was making a different decision.
'Even if I die, we need someone who can use the power of time for our comrades.'
There was only one person who could take on that role.
Enya. She was currently aboard Laprarosa. But strangely, she felt Quicantel's voice resonating within her.
'...Lord Quicantel!?'
'Enya, the people need you.'
The power of time.
Enya was facing the authority of the Silver Dragon that Quicantel possessed, filling her inner self like water. Like a river, like a road, a silver water was spreading before Enya's eyes.

It was a river only Enya could see, and in Enya's sight, only that silver river was churning. Everyone else standing around her was frozen as if time had stopped, and the battlefield visible beyond the bridge was also completely still.
'So follow the path and come here. I am sorry.'
Instinctively, Enya realized that if she crossed that silver river, she would reach the Genesis Knights' battlefield.

She couldn't understand the principle. She only knew clearly that the power of time Quicantel had poured out in her final resistance against Olta was temporarily separating the two of them from this world's time.
'I'm coming.'
To protect her comrades, she summoned her contractor to the crucible of the world's most dangerous battlefield.
But paradoxically, that was a way of protecting Enya. If she missed this urgent moment despite having the only power that could help her comrades, Enya would become unable to accept herself.
Enya sprinted down the silver river with all her might.
It felt like the frozen time would be released at any moment and she would miss her chance. She could not let the opportunity Quicantel had so desperately created turn to nothing.
"Hah, heok, heok!"
She ran with the single-minded determination to get there even if she died from shortness of breath.
The scene she faced as soon as she crossed the silver river was, once again, the chaotic and rapidly moving battlefield, the enemies, and far in the distance, Quicantel's corpse.
"I'll see you again later, Master Quicantel."
Enya did not approach Quicantel's body. The point she had arrived at after crossing the silver river was right next to Jin and Valeria.
"Enya? How?"
"Valeria! I will take Master Quicantel's place."
A silver magic was flowing from Enya's staff. The magic of time. That power flowed as gently as the wind and mixed into Valeria's blue magic.
Then, Jin's suddenly aged face began to slowly return to normal. His shriveled muscles filled out, and his thinned bones filled out again.

Thus, everyone was creating a miracle. Everyone was burning like a fire. Now Jin had to protect Valeria and Enya, and the two of them had to restore all the allies who had been struck by Kelliark's aging curse.
A constantly updating recording window, the silver and blue magic etched onto the window to reverse the manipulation of aging.
"Can you really reverse everything with just that?"
Kelliark's dry voice echoed across the battlefield.
Even with the continuing miracles, it was impossible for Valeria and Enya's power alone to block the manipulation and distortion he was causing.
Chiron Runcandel was experiencing the most severe aging. Despite that, Chiron was fighting on, transcending even his old and weakened body, but there would surely be a limit.
He aged and de-aged in a matter of seconds.
The gods and phoenixes summoned by Kelliark persistently poured their authority and fire on him whenever he temporarily aged.

Van, Luna, and Orgal were blocking Kelliark's daggers as best they could, but that too seemed to have a determined future. The magic of aging was spreading to all the Genesis Knights without a moment's rest.
[Gaaaaah!]
Even when Tess was summoned to face Kelliark's phoenixes, they did not fear her. They all descended without hesitation to bite Tess's neck.
"A phoenix because it does not die, yet I have killed countless phoenixes. They are pitiful beings who cannot exist for even a second if the realm of fire is gone. You will be no different, Tess."
[Even after conquering so many worlds, you seem to be seething with anger for not obtaining me. Try it, Kelliark. See if I am truly no different.]
Jiiiiiik-!
Tess's right wing, which the phoenixes had been biting, was torn. Kelliark's beam had sliced through it like a sword. His own phoenixes were cut down along with it, but it was of no consequence.
The bisected bodies of the phoenixes were pressing down on Tess and Jin. The protective shield was melting from the heat, and Tess, panting heavily, glared at Kelliark.
Kelliark was pointing at the sky.
At the end of the sky, at the Realm of Fire that existed loftily beyond it, the land where the order of reincarnation flowed. Soon, as he waved his hand once, the sky was seen splitting in half.
'The Realm of Fire...!'

Filled with blazing fire, Tess's domain was being revealed between the split sky. Countless phoenixes that had not yet chosen a contractor, and souls walking the path of reincarnation would be in that fire.

"Zito, your equal, was annihilated at the hands of your contractor, and the hell of this world is not fulfilling its role. Since even your contractor managed it, it is an easy task for me. Behold, the order you have protected for eons is this fragile."
Grrrrrrrk...!
As Kelliark clenched his fist, the entire Realm of Fire was crumpling like a sheet of paper.
The path of reincarnation was cut, the souls passing along it burst and scattered, and the phoenixes and those not yet fully formed could not even scream.
"Solderet and the Witch must have been confident, perceiving that even they could not reach the Realm of Fire. How dare you oppose me, you who are merely one of the common immortals."
[Guaaaaaargh...!]

The collapse of the Realm of Fire was like Tess's own essence being torn apart. Tess's flame quickly faded, and Jin felt the oppressive force that had been protecting him from Kelliark's phoenixes weaken.
Looking back, at every moment of crisis.
Tess had saved Jin countless times. But now, Jin could not save Tess.
[Jin! Do not think like that.]
Suddenly, Tess, having shrunk to the size of a hawk, fell onto Jin's shoulder.
"Tess..."

[Look there. Golden flowers are blooming even in the collapsed Realm of Fire. Just as they are blooming all over this battlefield... It is your power. Your influence. It is proof that you have not fallen to that bastard! I have existed for longer than I can remember, but this short time I spent by your side was the most fulfilling.]
Just as she said, the Authority of Regeneration that Jin possessed was now shimmering even in the completely destroyed Realm of Fire.
Of course, there was much he wanted to say. Like with all the other comrades who had died so far, there were too many things left unsaid.
But Jin simply nodded his head. By then, Tess was no longer on his shoulder.
However, one thing: Tess had not simply vanished. Just as Quicantel had done, she had squeezed out all her remaining power and settled into Jin's Light-Heart.
Eternity and immortality, the symbols of the phoenix and their queen, Tess.
Though trivial in Kelliark's eyes, Tess's eternal immortality would now protect Jin from aging until the war was over.
"...Valeria, Enya. I no longer age from his manipulation. So please focus on the others."
The two nodded.
Even if they lost their god, lost their guardian, lost their comrades, even if the unquenchable fire had just been extinguished.
The will to resist had to keep burning.
